title: CHAIR -- Classifier of Hallucination as Improver
abstract: arXiv:2501.02518v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work, we introduce CHAIR (Classifier of Hallucination As ImproveR), a supervised framework for detecting hallucinations by analyzing internal logits from each layer of every token. Our method extracts a compact set of features such as maximum, minimum, mean, standard deviation, and slope-from the token logits across all layers, enabling effective hallucination detection without overfitting. Experiments on TruthfulQA and MMLU datasets demonstrate that CHAIR significantly improves detection accuracy, particularly in zero-shot scenarios, showcasing its robustness and generalizability. Beyond hallucination detection, CHAIR highlights the potential of using internal representations for designing advanced decoding strategies. By leveraging patterns in logits, we suggest that more sophisticated models and adaptive decoding methods could further reduce hallucinations and enhance text completion quality. translated_title: CHAIR——作为改进器的幻觉分类器
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了CHAIR（Classifier of Hallucination As ImproveR），一个通过分析每个词元在每一层的内部logits来检测幻觉的监督式框架。我们的方法从所有层的词元logits中提取一组紧凑的特征，如最大值、最小值、均值、标准差和斜率，从而在不发生过拟合的情况下实现有效的幻觉检测。在TruthfulQA和MMLU数据集上的实验表明，CHAIR显著提升了检测准确率，尤其是在零样本场景中，展现了其鲁棒性和泛化能力。除了幻觉检测之外，CHAIR还凸显了利用内部表示来设计高级解码策略的潜力。通过利用logits中的模式，我们认为更精细的模型和自适应解码方法可以进一步减少幻觉并提升文本补全的质量。CHAIR不仅提供了一个实用的（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: CHAIR通过提取每个词元在所有层中logits的紧凑统计特征来检测大语言模型的幻觉，在零样本场景下显著提升检测准确率，并展示了利用内部表示设计自适应解码策略以减少幻觉的潜力。
en_tdlr: CHAIR is a supervised framework that detects LLM hallucinations by extracting compact statistical features from token logits across all layers, significantly improving detection accuracy especially in zero-shot settings and revealing the potential of internal representations for adaptive decoding strategies.
